name: Connie Facio
source:
She strongly believes in theology and respects Pontiff Claire's wisdom; she often asks him questions about theology. She loves children and is saving money to build an orphanage one day. 

She was born into a wealthy family in the central district but had witnessed many poor men suffer. Becoming a nun was her way of escaping an arranged marriage.

[Edited from in-game bio]
